metadata.title: feat(testing): add compose load testing + tracing stack Locust, Tempo, A2A
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
Add docker-compose profiles for end-to-end testing and observability:

- testing profile: containerized Locust (master/worker) with JWT bootstrap, fast_test_server, A2A echo agent, and auto-registration into the gateway
- monitoring profile: Tempo tracing backend and Grafana datasource wiring for Loki <-> Tempo pivots

Developer experience improvements:
- Makefile targets for testing/monitoring/performance stacks and a headless containerized load test (reports in ./reports)
- Fix compose permissions so locust_token can write to its volume and Locust can write bind-mounted reports (run as host uid/gid; HOME=/tmp)

A2A echo agent:
- Move implementation to a2agents/go/a2a-echo-agent
- Implement A2A v0.3.x agent card discovery and JSON-RPC endpoint using a2a-go

Observability/logging:
- Update promtail JSON parsing fields to match gateway structured logs (request_id, trace_id, span_id, @timestamp)
- Respect LOG_FORMAT=json|text for console logging and include OTEL trace/span ids in JSON logs
- Add OTLP exporters to the Python observability extra

Docs:
- Update load testing docs to reference tests/loadtest and the compose testing workflow

Refs #2709

commits.message:
feat(testing): add compose load testing + tracing stack (Locust, Tempo, A2A)

Add docker-compose profiles for end-to-end testing and observability:

- testing profile: containerized Locust (master/worker) with JWT bootstrap, fast_test_server, A2A echo agent, and auto-registration into the gateway

- monitoring profile: Tempo tracing backend and Grafana datasource wiring for Loki <-> Tempo pivots

Developer experience improvements:

- Makefile targets for testing/monitoring/performance stacks and a headless containerized load test (reports in ./reports)

- Fix compose permissions so locust_token can write to its volume and Locust can write bind-mounted reports (run as host uid/gid; HOME=/tmp)

A2A echo agent:

- Move implementation to a2agents/go/a2a-echo-agent

- Implement A2A v0.3.x agent card discovery and JSON-RPC endpoint using a2a-go

Observability/logging:

- Update promtail JSON parsing fields to match gateway structured logs (request_id, trace_id, span_id, @timestamp)

- Respect LOG_FORMAT=json|text for console logging and include OTEL trace/span ids in JSON logs

- Add OTLP exporters to the Python observability extra

Docs:

- Update load testing docs to reference tests/loadtest and the compose testing workflow

Refs #2709
